# Carnegie Mellon University

> > A leading research university pioneering advances in artificial intelligence, robotics, computer science, performing arts, and interdisciplinary innovation.

Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) is home to over 100 research centers and institutes, including the renowned Robotics Institute, and fosters groundbreaking work across technology, arts, and entrepreneurship. The university emphasizes interdisciplinary collaboration through programs like IDeATe and has produced innovations ranging from AI systems like Andy 2 and FRIDA to successful startups including Duolingo and ModCloth.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence
- Robotics Institute
- Research & Creativity
- Interdisciplinary Innovation
- IDeATe (Integrative Design, Arts, and Technology)
- Entrepreneurship
- Performing Arts
- Andy 2 (AI System)
- FRIDA (Robotic Artist)
- Sensabot
- Computer Science
- Human-Computer Interaction
- Machine Learning
- Innovation Ecosystems
